summary: Iteration 3 full test (backend + mobile web 390x844). Backend: 51/51 pytest pass (41 previous + 10 new in test_iter3_stages_finance.py covering category/payment_completed, stages owner/employee/400/404, planned payments CRUD+pay+403, finance report, PATCH toggles, employee schedules). Frontend: all requested flows work: Projeler segments with counts + filtering, stage 'n/N label' on cards, no money on projects list/detail (owner+employee); create job with category chips, Bitmiş İş -> Ödeme Tamamlandı toggle, shows 'Ödeme tamamlandı' in Finans > İş Bakiyeleri; Evraklar checklist per category (7 kadastro / 7 belediye types, x/N tamam), src-file upload turns type checked; Süreç stepper save moves stage + history note; Diğer shows free-form steps; Arazi schedule add/edit(status)/double-tap delete; Takvim add/toggle/edit; project-finance KPIs, amounts save, planned + payment add, completed toggle (remaining 0 / restore), WhatsApp + PDF buttons; Finans Özet KPIs, upcoming 'Tahsil Edildi' (removes row, KPI updates), income-expense monthly/yearly + year nav; Giderler add/double-tap delete. Employee: sees only assigned jobs, no FAB/Finans tab/finance btn, /project-finance and /finance redirect to /projects, can update stage and add/edit schedules. Only minor issues found (Turkish uppercase İ, small touch targets, a few English 404 details, logic nits).

minor.issue: No scope check: any employee can change status of ANY schedule (not only assigned/created ones); also returns ok for non-existent id instead of 404. server.py:615-620
HTTPException(404) raised without detail -> frontend shows English 'Not Found'. server.py:612,653,665,773,786. Add Turkish detail e.g. 'Kayıt bulunamadı'
find_one then update_one is not atomic; two concurrent taps can create 2 payments. Use find_one_and_update({id, status:'bekliyor'} -> odendi) first, then insert payment
Sending category equal to current value still resets stage_index to 0 (should only reset when category actually changes)

Finished job (status 'bitti') of kadastro/belediye category is created at stage 0 'Eksik evrak bekleniyor' (1/6) instead of last stage 'İşlem tamamlandı' — card/Süreç show a finished job as waiting for missing docs
Employee can create a schedule with project_id of a project they are not assigned to (no scope check)
Legacy projects ('151/4 Acısu...', 'Test Projesi') have no category/stage_index field in DB (frontend falls back to diger). Consider a startup migration setting category='diger', stage_index=0

ui_bugs.issue: textTransform:'uppercase' produces wrong Turkish casing: 'GIDER', 'GELIR', 'DIĞER İŞLER' instead of 'GİDER', 'GELİR', 'DİĞER İŞLER'. Files: finance.tsx:201, finance-parts.tsx:208,218, projects.tsx:312,324, project/[id].tsx:612,630,635, project-finance/[id].tsx:297, calendar.tsx:182. Fix: write labels with toLocaleUpperCase('tr-TR') and drop textTransform

issues: seg-* 38px and filter-* chips 36px high (<44 touch target)

design_issues.issue_note: presentationStyle='pageSheet' modal renders as partial sheet on web; lower fields (input-finished, Kaydet) initially outside viewport, required scroll — fine on native
issues: pageSheet modal partially offscreen on web preview

Add scope check + 404 to POST /api/schedules/{sid}/status for employees
Add Turkish detail to bare HTTPException(404) calls
When creating a finished (bitti) kadastro/belediye job, set stage_index to last stage; only reset stage on PATCH when category actually changes
Increase touch targets (back-btn, tab pills, seg/filter chips) to >=44px
Optionally remove leftover test user 'UI Emp' (uitest_9d59s6@haritapro.com) created in a previous iteration — it shows in Atanan Çalışanlar chips

project/[id].tsx is 662 lines - near the 700-line limit; consider splitting tabs into components
